summary: Executed backend + frontend testing for Tax Engine scope. Core requested social-solidarity flows are blocked by organization module gating: electronic_invoice is disabled for social-solidarity, causing /api/tax-engine/profile and dependent endpoints to fail with 404. UI confirms Tax Engine card hidden for social-solidarity and visible for general-union.

critical.issue: Returns 404 with detail: 'الفاتورة الإلكترونية غير متاحة لمشروع التكافل الاجتماعي'. This blocks GET/PUT profile, invoice creation, approval, audit verification, and tenant isolation checks in requested org.

ui_bugs.issue: Electronic Invoice module card is not shown for social-solidarity while request expects it enabled and testable.

integration_issues.flow: Tax Engine profile/invoice flow for social-solidarity
integration_issues.issue: Frontend visibility and backend access are both gated off for the target tenant, so integration flow cannot run in requested organization.

action_items: Enable organization module electronic_invoice=true for social-solidarity in effective organization modules source used at login/authorization.
After enabling, rerun /app/backend/tests/test_iteration83_tax_engine_profile_and_invoices.py to validate requested Tax Engine endpoints and approval/audit flow end-to-end.
Re-verify /electronic-invoice page in social-solidarity shows Tax Engine Profile and tax sales/purchase buttons.
Then retest multi-tenant isolation against general-union once social flow is unblocked.
critical_code_review_comments: Tax Engine endpoints are correctly behind require_einvoice_enabled, but tenant module configuration is inconsistent with product requirement for social-solidarity.
Single-file backend server.py remains very large (>10k LOC), increasing regression risk when toggling tenant/module auth behavior.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. No TEST_TAX_ENGINE_AUTOMATION_DELETE_ME invoices were created because social-solidarity tax endpoints were blocked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Evidence gathered: login payload shows social-solidarity organization_modules.electronic_invoice=false, while general-union shows electronic_invoice=true. UI check with admin_takaful and admin_union confirms social accounting page hides module-electronic-invoice-card and union shows it. Backend pytest file is ready and currently fails at social tax profile setup due this gate.
rca of the issue: RCA: Tenant module configuration regression/mismatch. Reproduction: (1) POST /api/auth/login with admin/social-solidarity returns user.organization_modules.electronic_invoice=false. (2) GET /api/tax-engine/profile with that token returns 404 'الفاتورة الإلكترونية غير متاحة لمشروع التكافل الاجتماعي'. (3) UI social login -> accounting page shows no [data-testid='module-electronic-invoice-card']; union login shows card present. Mitigation: set social-solidarity electronic_invoice=true in organization modules data path consumed by auth and module checks, then rerun blocked tax-engine suite. ETA submit path remains CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED/OFFLINE_READY by design and was not auto-invoked.
